annotations.title: Crypto market state at a past minute

description: Use when backtesting and you need the market exactly as it was at a past minute: what the market looked like at any past minute since 9 Oct 2026, exactly as recorded then (no revisions, no lookahead): crypto perpetual futures (mark, oracle and mid price, hourly funding, premium, open interest, 24h volume, change over the previous hour and day) and the most traded prediction markets' odds. Up to 5 coins per call, and an optional per-minute series of up to 6 hours for one coin. Each snapshot carries the SHA-256 of the raw capture and the daily root committed on the Base network. US$0.01 per call; 3 free calls a day.

odds.description: Words to pick prediction markets, or 'none'.
